observations.amd_ppr_049: Model 02h C1 still defines CpuVid bit 32 plus bits 21:14, expected single-core ACPI _PSS current descriptors, and different per-processor/fabric consistency scopes. This page provides no complete VID-to-mV or IddDiv conversion table.
observations.linux_cpupower: Family 1Ah frequency remains 12-bit FID times 5 MHz. The tool does not establish a family-wide voltage/current write protocol.
observations.corefreq: Family 1Ah PSTATEDEF has ninth VID bit; distinct AMD_RMB, AMD_17h and AMD_VCO voltage formula paths exist. These observations are implementation references, not validation of all firmware/Threadripper models.
observations.decision: Do not replace known raw VID/Idd fields with a guessed universal conversion, or enable a one-core writer that violates the PPR scope. Existing read-only support preserved; model identity, scope enumeration and partial-write recovery remain required.
